internal.what: Copypaw hit a bug it did not expect.
internal.next: Run `copypaw doctor` and open an issue with its output: https://github.com/intesarjawad/copypaw/issues/new?template=bug.yml

video_open.what: Copypaw could not open the video {path}.
video_open.next: Re-export the clip as an H.264 MP4, then run `copypaw capture clip.mp4 --out out`.

video_frame_rate.what: Copypaw could not read the frame rate of {path}.
video_frame_rate.next: Re-export the clip as an H.264 MP4, then run `copypaw capture clip.mp4 --out out`.

video_timestamps.what: The frame times in {path} are invalid or not in increasing order.
video_timestamps.next: Re-export the clip as an H.264 MP4 with a constant frame rate, then run `copypaw capture clip.mp4 --out out`.

video_no_frames.next: Check that the clip plays and is not empty, then run `copypaw capture clip.mp4 --out out`.

video_decode.next: Re-export the clip as an H.264 MP4, then run `copypaw capture clip.mp4 --out out`.

no_animal_found.what: Copypaw found an animal in fewer than half the frames of the clip.
no_animal_found.next: Film the pet from the side so it stays in view, then run `copypaw capture clip.mp4 --out out`.

model_checksum.what: The model file {filename} does not match its pinned checksum: expected SHA-256 {expected}, actual {actual}.
model_checksum.next: Delete {filename} from the model cache if it is there, then run `copypaw models fetch`.

model_size.what: The model file {filename} has {actual} bytes; expected {expected} bytes.
model_size.next: Delete {filename} from the model cache if it is there, then run `copypaw models fetch`.

model_download.next: Check your network connection, then run `copypaw models fetch`.

model_cache.what: Copypaw cannot write to the model cache {path}: {reason}
model_cache.next: Point the cache at a folder you can write to with `COPYPAW_CACHE=~/copypaw-models copypaw models fetch`.

output_directory.what: Copypaw cannot write to the output folder {path}: {reason}
output_directory.next: Run the command again with `--out` set to a folder you can write to.

mask_too_small.what: The drawing covers too little of the page.
mask_too_small.next: Draw a larger pet on a plain, light background. Examples: https://github.com/intesarjawad/copypaw/tree/main/samples/worst_case

mask_too_large.what: The drawing covers too much of the page.
mask_too_large.next: Leave a clear margin between the pet and the page edge. Examples: https://github.com/intesarjawad/copypaw/tree/main/samples/worst_case

mask_multiple_creatures.what: The page contains more than one drawing.
mask_multiple_creatures.next: Show one pet per page. Examples: https://github.com/intesarjawad/copypaw/tree/main/samples/worst_case

motion_unreadable.what: Copypaw could not read {path} as a motion file.
motion_unreadable.next: Create a fresh motion file with `copypaw capture clip.mp4 --out out`.

motion_missing_key.what: The motion file is missing the key {key}.
motion_missing_key.next: Create a fresh motion file with `copypaw capture clip.mp4 --out out`.

motion_version.what: The motion file is version {found}; Copypaw reads version {expected}.
motion_version.next: Create a fresh motion file with `copypaw capture clip.mp4 --out out`.

motion_invalid.what: The motion file key {key} is invalid: {problem}.
motion_invalid.next: Create a fresh motion file with `copypaw capture clip.mp4 --out out`.

drawing_unreadable.what: Copypaw could not read {path} as an image.
drawing_unreadable.next: Save the drawing as a PNG or JPEG, then run `copypaw rig drawing.png -o rig`.

joints_invalid.what: The joints file {path} is not usable: {problem}.
joints_invalid.next: Write a fresh one with `copypaw rig drawing.png -o rig`, edit the numbers it prints, then pass the file with `--joints`.

character_missing.what: {path} is not a rigged drawing: {name} is missing.
character_missing.next: Rig the drawing with `copypaw rig drawing.png -o rig`, then run `copypaw animate rig motion.npz --clip clip.mp4 -o out`.

app_static_missing.what: The local app has no built web page in {path}.
app_static_missing.next: Build it with `cd web && npm ci && npm run build`, then run `copypaw app`.

app_port.next: Run `copypaw app` without `--port` to use a free port.

app_body_too_large.what: The file is larger than the {limit_mb} MB Copypaw accepts.
app_body_too_large.next: Trim the clip to a few seconds or use a smaller photo, then pick it again with Choose a clip or Choose a photo.

app_request.what: The page sent a request Copypaw cannot use: {problem}.
app_request.next: Reload the address `copypaw app` printed and start again.

capture_anatomy.what: Copypaw could not track the required anatomy. {problem}
capture_anatomy.next: Film again from the side with the whole pet visible, including all four paws. Follow https://github.com/intesarjawad/copypaw/blob/main/docs/filming_guide.md
